Rahul Gandhi addresses tribal students on education and identity

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi addressed tribal students, stating they are fighting for their identity and existence. He urged teachers to build an equal opportunity and universal education system. Gandhi's remarks focused on the challenges faced by tribal communities in asserting their rights and cultural distinctiveness within the educational framework. The event highlighted the importance of inclusive education that respects and preserves the identity of all students.
